rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Sensitive cookies where the SameSite attribute is set to "None" can in some cases allow for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
rules.description: Allocating objects or timers with user-controlled sizes or durations can cause resource exhaustion.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: assigning important environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
rules.description: Misconfiguration of CORS HTTP headers allows for leaks of secret credentials.

rules.cwe_name: Excessive Iteration
rules.description: Iterating over an object with a user-controlled .length property can cause indefinite looping.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
rules.description: Matching HTML tags using regular expressions is hard to do right, and can easily lead to security issues.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: Processing user-controlled object hierarchies inefficiently can lead to denial of service.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
rules.description: Building an XPath expression from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
rules.description: Building a database query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs
rules.description: Building log entries from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of forged log entries by a malicious user.
